Daily Quiz.question: ২) 'The Black Cat' is a short story written by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
Edgar Allan Poe(1809–49):
American short-story writer, poet, critic, and editor who is famous for his cultivation of mystery and the macabre.
His some notable works are:
- The Black Cat
- The Tell-Tale Heart
- The Masque of the Red Death
- The Murders in the Rue Morgue
- The Fall of the House of Usher etc.
His ''The Raven'' (1845) numbers among the best-known poems in national literature.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

Daily Quiz.exp:
David Herbert Lawrence's well known novels:
- Lady Chatterley's Lover,

- The Rainbow,

- A Modern Lover.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Who is the central character of 'The Old Man and the Sea'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Old Man and the Sea, a short heroic novel by Ernest Hemingway, was published in 1952 and awarded the 1953 Pulitzer Prize for fiction. It was his last major work of fiction. The story centers on an aging fisherman who engages in an epic battle to catch a giant marlin.
The central character is an old Cuban fisherman named Santiago, who has not caught a fish for 84 days. The family of his apprentice, Manolin, has forced the boy to leave the old fisherman, though Manolin continues to support him with food and bait. Santiago is a mentor to the boy, who cherishes the old man and the life lessons he imparts.

Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Ernest Hemingway won the Nobel Prize in -
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Nobel Prize in Literature 1954 was awarded to Ernest Miller Hemingway "for his mastery of the art of narrative, most recently demonstrated in The Old Man and the Sea, and for the influence that he has exerted on contemporary style."

Source: Nobelprize.org

Daily Quiz.exp:
Novella, short and well-structured narrative, often realistic and satiric in tone, influenced the development of the short story and the novel throughout Europe.
The Metamorphosis is a novella written by Franz Kafka which was first published in 1915. 

Source: Britannica, Goodreads

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Pygmalion is a _______ by George Bernard Shaw.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Pygmalion is a play by George Bernard Shaw,
Pygmalion, romance in five acts by George Bernard Shaw, was produced in German in 1913 in Vienna. It was performed in England in 1914, with Mrs. Patrick Campbell as Eliza Doolittle. The play is a humane comedy about love and the English class system.

Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.exp:
Gabriel García Márquez won Nobel Prize in 1982.
Bertrand Russell won Nobel Prize in 1950.
George Bernard Shaw won Nobel Prize in 1925.
James Joyce never received a Nobel Prize.
Source: Nobel Prize website.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) 'The Proposed Roads to Freedom' contains Bertrand Russell's astute political commentary on
Daily Quiz.exp:
'The Proposed Roads to Freedom' contains Bertrand Russell's astute political commentary on anarchism, socialism, and syndicalism. Russell begins with a historical overview of socialism and anarchism, the teachings and organizations of Marx and Bakunin, and the syndicalist revolt against socialism.

Source: Amazon.com

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) ‘The Power and the Glory’ is a famous work of-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Graham Greene (2 October 1904 – 3 April 1991):
-In full Henry Graham Greene.
-English novelist, short-story writer, playwright, and journalist whose novels treat life’s moral ambiguities in the context of contemporary political settings.
- His notable works: Brighton Rock, The Power and the Glory (1940), The End of the Affair, A Burnt-Out Case, The Comedians, Our Man in Havana, The Quiet American, The Human Factor, Stamboul Train.

[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) ‘The God of Small Things’ is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Arundhati Roy is an Indian author, actress, and political activist who was best known for the award-winning novel 'The God of Small Things' (1997) and for her involvement in environmental and human rights causes.

His notable works: The Ministry of Utmost Happiness, The God of Small Things.

Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) “It's enough for me to be sure that you and I exist at this moment.” is a quote from -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) One Hundred Years of Solitude
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Love in the Time of Cholera
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Memories of My Melancholy Whores
Daily Quiz.exp:
গ্যাব্রিয়েল গার্সিয়া মার্কেজ কলম্বিয়ার একজন বিখ্যাত ঔপন্যাসিক। তাকে বিংশ শতাব্দীর অন্যতম শ্রেষ্ঠ লেখক বিবেচনা করা হয়। One Hundred Years oF Solitude তার একটি বিখ্যাত উপন্যাস।
এই উপন্যাসের বিখ্যাত কিছু উক্তি:
- “It's enough for me to be sure that you and I exist at this moment.”
- “There is always something left to love.”
- “They were so close to each other that they preferred death to separation”

(সূত্রঃ ব্রিটানিকা)

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) George Orwell's story 'Animal Farm' is written in the form of a/an -
Daily Quiz.exp:
George Orwell 's story Animal Farm is written in the form of an allegory. This story is an allegory because George Orwell uses the animals as symbolic figures to represent humans and the farm as a representation for a world war.

Source: https://www.ipl.org/

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Alice Munro is a -
Daily Quiz.exp:
Alice Munro একজন কানাডিয়ান ছোট গল্পকার। তিনি ২০০৯ সালে ম্যান বুকার ইটারন্যাশনাল প্রাইজ এবং ২০১৩ সালে সাহিত্যে নোবেল পুরস্কার লাভ করেন।

(সূত্রঃ লাইভ এমসিকিউ এবং ব্রিটানিকা)

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) ‘A Passage to India’ is written by -----
Daily Quiz.exp:
E.M. Forster's A Passage to India, which was published in 1924. It is widely considered to be Forster's finest work and it became his last novel, despite the fact that he remained active as a writer and critic for more than four decades after its publication.

Source: https://www.bl.uk/

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) 'Riders To The Sea’ is -
Daily Quiz.exp:
Riders to the Sea, a one-act play by John Millington Synge, was published in 1903 and produced in 1904. Riders to the Sea is set in the Aran Islands off the west coast of Ireland and is based on a tale Synge heard there. It won critical acclaim as one of dramatic literature’s greatest one-act plays.

Source: Britannica

- অন্যদিকে A Midsummer Night's Dream হলো William Shakespeare রচিত নাটক।
- Salman Rushdie রচিত গ্রন্থ হলো Midnight's Children.

(সূত্রঃ লাইভ এমসিকিউ এবং ব্রিটানিকা)

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Which of these is a science fiction novel by English author H.G. Wells?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The War of the Worlds
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The History of Mr. Polly
Daily Quiz.exp:
H.G. Wells(1866-1946):
- In full Herbert George Wells.
- English novelist, journalist, sociologist, and historian best known for such science fiction novels as The Time Machine and The  War of the Worlds and such comic novels as Tono-Bungay and The History of Mr. Polly.
- His other science fiction novels: The Wonderful Visit (1895), The Island of Doctor Moreau (1896), The Invisible Man (1897), The    First Men in the Moon (1901), and The Food of the Gods (1904).
- He also wrote many short stories, which were collected in The Stolen Bacillus (1895), The Plattner Story (1897), and Tales of          Space and Time (1899).

[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

His famous books:
Wings of Fire(an autobiography, 1999), Ignited Mind, Inspiring Thought, The Luminous Sparks, Turning Points, You are Born to Bloom, Target 3 Billion, Indomitable Spirit, My Journey etc.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]
